# 设置与持久化需求质量 Checklist: 屏幕录制器 (Screen Recorder)

**Purpose**: 验证配置项完整性、默认值、校验规则、生效时机与持久化/迁移需求是否明确
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all settings items enumerated (region range, storage location, and any others) with explicit scope boundaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §FR-017, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are default values defined for every setting? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the persistence location and format specified or explicitly delegated? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are validation rules for invalid values (out-of-bounds, non-numeric, missing folder) specified? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the effective time of each setting change (immediately, next recording, restart) defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is recovery behavior specified when the settings file is corrupted or from an unknown version? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is the coordinate unit and origin of the region range specified (DIP, primary display top-left)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the minimum region size quantified? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "合理默认值" for the storage location quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the folder picker behavior (create-if-missing, cancel, permission denied) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the settings form's validation feedback (inline errors, save blocking) specified enough to implement without ambiguity? [Clarity, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Do region bounds used in settings validation match the recording-time region constraints? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK013 - Does the default storage location align with the documented write-access assumption? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 - Is SC-005 (settings persist after restart) measurable with defined steps? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the expected behavior for invalid settings input testable? [Measurability, Spec Edge Cases]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 - Are requirements defined for changing settings while a recording is active? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are requirements defined for the storage folder being moved, deleted, or unmounted between sessions? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are requirements defined for validating region bounds under different DPI configurations? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional & Dependencies

- [ ] CHK019 - Is the settings file size or load-time expectation documented as non-functional requirement? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the assumption that settings live under the user profile (`userData`) documented? [Assumption, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
